evidence.reason: The current watchdog still writes the live state file in place with ST.write_text at line 49 (and line 35), so an interrupted write can leave invalid JSON. Line 30 then calls json.loads without handling JSONDecodeError, so every later invocation exits before it can alert or recover. This is an ordinary reliability defect in the watchdog, and atomic replacement plus explicit malformed-state handling is a minimal compatible repair.
